# Kremin Electric

Kremin Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor in Granada Hills, California, working since 1979.
We hold California C-10 electrical contractor license #380250.
We do residential, commercial, and industrial electrical work: panel upgrades and rewiring, lighting and fixtures, repairs and troubleshooting, and commercial tenant improvements.
Bill Kremin looks at each project himself and sends a written estimate by email or in person.
Estimates are free, and we guarantee labor and the materials we furnish for one year.
Seniors, veterans, and new customers get a 10% discount.
We dispatch from Granada Hills across the San Fernando Valley, greater Los Angeles, Santa Clarita, Pasadena, Burbank, Glendale, and Western Ventura County.
Address: 11024 Balboa Blvd., Suite 770, Granada Hills, CA 91344.
Phone: (818) 368-8809.
Email: ELECRFD@yahoo.com.
Website: https://kreminelectric.com/
